svg.title: Speedup over scalar for six loops across five compile targets
svg.desc: Heatmap. saxpy reaches 9x with AVX-512; leaky ReLU vectorizes only with AVX-512 masking; the strict-IEEE dot product gets slower with AVX-512 and fast only with -ffast-math; the prefix sum never vectorizes.

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Same compiler, same source: speedup over scalar depends on the loop, not the register

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: fp32, n = 4096 (in L1), gcc -O3 per target · Xeon (Emerald Rapids), 1 core, gcc 13.3
